column19: Populate with first critical transaction flow

business_purpose: Run recurring sanctions screening for account-linked contacts after sanctions list changes
trigger_input: Scheduled GitHub workflow or manual dispatch calling /actions/run_screening_process
validation_checks: Abort if sanctions files unavailable and skip if no sanctions delta or all targets already screened today
processing_steps: Compare sanctions files, load accounts and contacts, target in-scope contacts, create screenings including FATF listed-jurisdiction status, email workflow result
output_result: New contact_screening records and workflow summary
error_exception_handling: Workflow failure on token or sanctions availability issues and per-contact error capture during execution
reconciliation_verification_control: Review GitHub workflow result and confirm same-day screening records for targeted contacts

business_purpose: Send funding reminders to open accounts with zero or missing NAV
trigger_input: Weekly GitHub workflow or manual dispatch calling /actions/send_unfunded_emails
validation_checks: Require valid API token and usable client email before sending
processing_steps: Load NAV, clients, accounts, contacts, and advisors; filter open unfunded accounts; compute notice cadence; send email
output_result: Funding notification emails and response payload of targeted contacts
error_exception_handling: Workflow fails on route failure and skips invalid-email contacts without failing the full batch
reconciliation_verification_control: Review workflow logs and sent email counts against returned candidate list

business_purpose: Populate missing IBKR aliases for active accounts
trigger_input: Daily GitHub workflow or manual dispatch calling /actions/update_pending_alias
validation_checks: Exclude rejected closed and funded-pending accounts and require account id title and master account
processing_steps: Load clients report, filter pending aliases, generate alias, call IBKR alias update, notify result
output_result: Updated IBKR aliases and workflow email summary
error_exception_handling: Per-account update failures are logged while remaining accounts continue
reconciliation_verification_control: Review workflow email and IBKR alias values for updated accounts

trigger_input: Daily GitHub workflow or manual dispatch calling /etl/clients
validation_checks: Require valid pipeline config and capture success skipped and failed step counts
processing_steps: Run extract, backup, and transform stages for configured client sources
output_result: Refreshed resource files and ETL overview summary
error_exception_handling: Workflow retries route execution and fails with notification if ETL does not complete successfully
reconciliation_verification_control: Review ETL overview JSON and resource folder outputs after each run

trigger_input: Daily GitHub workflow or manual dispatch calling /etl/market_data
validation_checks: Require valid pipeline config and capture stage-level failure counts
processing_steps: Run extract, backup, and transform stages for configured market-data sources
output_result: Refreshed market-data resources and ETL overview summary
error_exception_handling: Workflow fails and notifies on ETL errors
reconciliation_verification_control: Review ETL overview JSON and resulting resource files after each run

business_purpose: Review holder-document completeness for recently opened accounts manually relink or delete orphaned raw documents correct incomplete contact-document metadata and inspect IBKR compliance task backlogs
trigger_input: User opens Documents Review operational tabs and performs review actions
validation_checks: Exclude trusted contacts and apply required-document rules by holder type
processing_steps: Load accounts contacts IBKR details documents responsibles and users build review rows assign responsible users upload documents relink or delete orphaned raw documents correct missing type metadata send missing-document emails and display the provided IBKR compliance task snapshot
output_result: Reviewer assignments document uploads relinked corrected and deleted document records missing-document outreach and exportable IBKR compliance task rows
error_exception_handling: Page toasts surface data-load upload relink delete metadata-save and email failures for operator follow-up while the IBKR task tab remains read-only
reconciliation_verification_control: Review exported rows reviewer assignments uploaded document records relinked corrected or deleted document entries and the IBKR compliance task export

business_purpose: Identify and remediate missing or expiring proof-of-identity metadata
trigger_input: User opens POI Expiration Review page and updates document metadata
validation_checks: Parse expiration dates and classify missing expired expiring-soon and valid records
processing_steps: Load contacts account links accounts and document metadata, classify POI expiration state, edit metadata where needed
output_result: Updated contact-document metadata and exportable review rows
error_exception_handling: Page toasts surface data-load and update failures
reconciliation_verification_control: Review exported rows and updated document metadata after remediation

business_purpose: Review operational account metadata for anomalies and follow-up
trigger_input: User opens Accounts page and applies operational filters
validation_checks: Normalize missing display fields and derive contact labels through fallback matching
processing_steps: Load accounts with metadata plus advisors and contacts, derive labels, apply filters, navigate to account or application detail
output_result: Filtered operational account view and downstream follow-up navigation
error_exception_handling: Page toasts surface load failures and inconsistent metadata remains visible for manual review
reconciliation_verification_control: Review filtered populations and downstream corrective actions in account/application screens
